intent: poll an endpoint, send warmup traffic, then stop

title: retry the probe on non-2xx answers and connection errors until the timeout
why: A starting application answers with errors or refuses connections before it is ready. PR 29 states that both are retried every poll interval (default 500 ms) and that the timeout message names the last result, for example HTTP 503.
alternative: Fail on the first error. Unknown whether it was considered.

title: fail training when a warmup request or the warmup script fails
why: PR 29 states that an archive trained on a half-finished warmup would be misleading, so a failure is an error and not a silent skip.

title: return at once when the application exits while the probe waits
why: The runner then judges the exit code. Probing a dead process would only wait for the timeout (PR 29). The poll pause itself is a waitFor on the process, so it also wakes when the application dies.
alternative: Keep probing until the timeout. Unknown.

title: stop the application when a ReadyCondition throws an unchecked exception
why: Found while writing the probe: an exception from the ready condition left the application process running. The runner now stops it and reports a TrainingException. A test checks that the process is no longer alive (PR 29).
alternative: Let the exception propagate as before. That left a running process.

title: let http-probe train any kind of JAR
why: PR 29 states that non-Spring executable JARs can now be trained through the CLI, which resolves the limit of issue 5.
alternative: Limit it to Spring Boot JARs like spring-refresh.

name: HttpProbeExitMode
role: Polls a URL until it answers 2xx, makes the warmup GET requests in order, runs an optional warmup script, then lets the runner stop the application
conditions: Probe URL must be an absolute http or https URL; warmup paths resolve against the scheme and host of the probe URL; the script gets the base URL and must exit 0

name: HttpProbeExitMode.Settings
role: Probe URL, poll interval, warmup requests and warmup script

name: build command http-probe options
conditions: --url is required for this mode; exit code 2 if it is missing

subject: Not seen on a real Spring Boot actuator
why: PR 29 says the probe was tested with a local HTTP server and a small test application, not with a real Spring Boot actuator endpoint, and the warmup script only through a fake command runner.
